hooks.command: node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/check-setup.mjs" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Brief Town is not set up on this computer yet, and Node.js may not be installed (the setup check could not run). If they agree, follow the brief-town-setup skill, starting with the Node.js check.'
